license: CC BY-SA 4.0 text; images per their Commons pages; snapshot kept local only
kind: encyclopedia article with ~45 content images: labeled vector diagram (served as PNG thumbnail), photos, animations

requiredButtons.labelSource: caption text in the surrounding thumbnail block (no alt, no <figcaption>)
requiredButtons.why: Most Wikipedia images have empty alt; the meaning is in the caption div.

requiredButtons.labelSource: no alt or caption: fall back to the file name ('Heart anterior exterior view')

textView.lazyImages: about 40 images are lazy-loaded (no pixels until scrolled into view); each must still get a button, and opening it must load the full image
skip: Commons/Wikibooks logos and other icons under 32 px

tactile.coordinateSpace: pixels of the original SVG rendered at its own width/height [x0, y0, x1, y1]; tolerance 25 px
tactile.vectorPath: the page shows a 250 px PNG thumbnail; shapes come from the multimodal model's structured tactile graphic (LONG_TERM_PLAN §9), not from the file page

overview1x.fit: about 35 rows tall, centered, about 36 pins wide
shapes: outer heart wall / pericardium as one closed outline
septum between left and right ventricles as one line
the four chambers as closed regions separated by walls
vessels as tube outlines leaving the top: superior vena cava, aorta arch, pulmonary artery; inferior vena cava at the bottom
pulmonary veins as short tube stubs on both sides
every region is an outline only, no fill or texture inside
drop: all label text and dotted leader lines (labels go to components and the caption rows)
shading and color gradients (no pins for color)
colour meaning as texture: never; blue (oxygen-poor) and red (oxygen-rich) are named in labels only
overview1x.language: the SVG holds every label in 5 languages inside <switch systemLanguage>; only the user's language (English) is used
overview1x.deviceCheck: By touch: find the aorta arch at the top and follow it down into the heart.

isolateLeftVentricle.action: Enter on Chambers, then Enter on Left ventricle
isolateLeftVentricle.expect: left ventricle re-fit to the canvas: its wall, the septum side and the mitral and aortic valve openings at its top; fill <= 0.25

zoom.expect: valve shapes and chordae appear at 4x; fill stays <= 0.25

children.label: Pulmonary veins
children.note: two groups, left and right of the heart

componentChecks: labels come from the SVG <text> elements (English), matched to the nearest shape through their leader lines
each labeled part's pins lie inside its box
finger on the right atrium says 'Right atrium', and says it is on the left side of the picture (anatomical right vs. image left)

tree.action: split 'Pulmonary veins' into 'Left pulmonary veins' and 'Right pulmonary veins'
tree.expect: two components, one on each side
Enter on Left ventricle lists the mitral valve

pins.action: draw the blood-flow path from the right atrium into the right ventricle
pins.expect: the path stays attached to the chambers it crosses and survives zoom and reopen
